verdict.rationale: Mistral markets Document AI for compliance-first organizations needing secure on-premises deployment (supp-1). It also states OCR 4 is compact enough to run in a single container, keeping document data in your environment for residency and sovereignty (docs-38). Both are marketing-level claims; self-hosting appears to come through enterprise sales, and the documented developer workflow is the hosted API. Missing for 10: technical self-hosting or VPC deployment documentation (container images, install and scaling guides), clarity on whether the full annotation/QnA stack or only the OCR model can be self-hosted, and independent or hands-on confirmation of on-prem runs.
